visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a man in an indoor fitness studio or home gym environment. He is standing in a batting stance, wearing a black t-shirt and athletic shorts. He swings a baseball bat and hits a ball off a stationary tee, showing focused facial expressions and a strong follow-through. The room has mirrors on the wall reflecting the equipment and his form. (2) The scene undergoes a series of rapid jump cuts. In each cut, the man is wearing a different outfit—a dark blue tank top, an orange t-shirt, a black sleeveless shirt, and a blue performance shirt. He continues to hit baseballs off the tee in the same mirrored room, demonstrating a repetitive and rigorous training process. The lighting remains bright and consistent throughout these shifts. (3) The location transitions to a professional indoor batting cage with green artificial turf flooring and black protective netting. The man, now in a grey t-shirt, continues his batting practice, hitting multiple balls in quick succession. The background reveals other batting lanes and training gear, while his movements remain intense and rhythmic, concluding the practice session.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a powerful rock track featuring distorted electric guitars and a driving drum beat. Accompanying the first visual movement is a sharp, resonant impact sound of a bat hitting a baseball, which is repeated in each subsequent cut. (2) The music continues at a steady 140 BPM with an energetic male vocalist singing over the rock instrumentation. Every swing seen on screen is meticulously synchronized with the loud, percussive SFX of the ball hit, creating a rhythmic and percussive audio experience. (3) As the location shifts, the sonic profile remains focused on the interplay between the loud rock music and the recurring hits. The ambient environment is completely masked by the high-arousal musical track and the intentional post-production impact sound effects that highlight the athlete's strikes.
